card.name: Export restrictions and AUC in PK
card.fires_on: The word after "export" such as taxes or restrictions in trade-policy text, and the "UC" in AUC when a drug raises or lowers exposure.

modes.label: Export trade measures
modes.description: Taxes or restrictions right after the word export in food-trade policy text.
modes.example: it is not uncommon for countries to impose restrictions such as “export<< taxes>>” or “export embargoes”

modes.label: AUC in interaction studies
modes.description: The UC part of AUC, followed by Cmax, when a co-administered drug changes exposure.
modes.example: a single dose co-administration of 250 mL double strength grapefruit juice with 10 mg nifedipine increased A<<UC>> and C max by factors of 1
